info.title: Spellbook OpenAPI Schema
info.description: Spellbook shared account authentication and the versioned MTG API. API mutations affect the authenticated account only. Replaced API paths are removed; clients must use the current documented operations. Native FastAPI routing accepts canonical paths without trailing slashes or redirects. HEAD and OPTIONS are not registered and return 405 on known paths. Scalar queries select the last value; list parameters retain all values. Request validation uses safe 400 errors. This pre-release API provides no cross-version compatibility or stored-data upgrade guarantee.

sessionCookie.name: spellbook_session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque local session cookie set by browser login.

bearerToken.description: Opaque local session token returned by /api/v1/auth/login or /api/v1/auth/register.

requesterSecret.description: Returned only for device requests. Never place this secret in a QR, URL or log.

review.description: Code-scoped session marker supplied by the approval page

token.description: Device bearer token only; absent for browser redemption.

message.const: Your collection totals exceed the supported reporting range.

profileCard.description: Only supplied card fields are merged into the saved card.

username.description: Case-insensitive username, normalized by trimming and lowercasing.
After trimming and lowercasing: starts with a letter or digit; remaining characters are letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

artworkId.description: Optional profile artwork from the local library.

token.description: Opaque bearer token. Store securely; the JSON API does not set a browser cookie.

colors.description: Match a nonempty subset of selected colors. C also accepts colorless cards; C alone accepts only colorless cards.

colorIdentity.description: Match color identities that are subsets of the selected palette, including empty identities. C alone accepts only empty identities. C adds no restriction to a colored palette.

sets.description: Set codes are normalized to lowercase.

CatalogFilters.description: Categories combine with AND. Rarities, types, legalities, and sets combine with OR within each category. Empty arrays apply no restriction.

InventoryEntryUpdate.description: Supply quantity or delta, not both. Omitted fields remain unchanged. Notes requires notesRevision. Zero delta is invalid. At least one field is required.

delta.description: Nonzero signed quantity delta. Ordinary decreases stop at one copy; use DELETE to remove the entry.

candidates.description: Each catalogCardId must identify a different printing.

kind.description: Reviewed domain failure kind when applicable.

oneOf.description: Explicit Demo deployments only. A static fixture, not a current or historical market observation.
Explicit Demo deployments only. A static fixture, not a current or historical market observation.
Explicit Demo deployments only. A static fixture, not a current or historical market observation.

ColorMatch.description: (OR any selected color) AND every required color, excluding every not color. Empty any adds no restriction; omitted not is empty. Arrays must be pairwise disjoint. Additional card colors are permitted unless excluded; C means an empty color set.
